name: Main Street Yield
oneLiner: msY is the ERC-4626-style strategy vault token over msUSD, with exchange-rate appreciation from Main Street's delta-neutral options and derivatives book.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: msY resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

collateral: msUSD strategy vault shares backed by Main Street's delta-neutral options and derivatives strategy reserve; exchange-rate gains accrue to msY holders
pegMechanism: ERC-4626-style staking token over msUSD; users stake msUSD for msY, whose exchange rate appreciates with strategy returns, while final USDC redemption inherits Main Street's primary-market caps and cooldowns

mintAuthority.summary: msY is an ERC-4626-style strategy wrapper over Main Street USD. Wrapper minting creates msY shares against deposited MSUSD, while durable base-dollar issuance is inherited from the reviewed MSUSD parent.

controls.label: msY ERC-4626-style wrapper
controls.capDescription: The wrapper mints msY shares through deposit/mint flows against MSUSD asset deposits; it does not mint base MSUSD.
controls.evidence: asset() returned 0x4ba01f22827018b4772CD326C7627FB4956A7C00, the Ethereum MSUSD parent; implementation ABI exposes deposit/mint/redeem/withdraw wrapper functions.

controls.label: msY owner Safe
controls.evidence: owner() returned this Safe at Ethereum block 25166595; on-chain Safe reads returned threshold 3 and 4 owners. Modules were checked from the Safe sentinel and returned empty, but guard state was not verified.

controls.label: Inherited MSUSD mint surface
controls.evidence: Parent MSUSD metadata already records a reviewed 2026-05-24 mintAuthority profile; msY inherits durable base issuance from that parent.

review.evidence: Local variant metadata, parent MSUSD mintAuthority, and Ethereum RPC/source reads show msY as a wrapper over MSUSD rather than a separate base stablecoin mint path.
